_note: Soft-proof invariant (02-02): export is never proofed. Before the png stage the checker seeds the isolated profile's preferences.xml with <inkscape version="1"><group id="options"><group id="softproof" enable="1"/></group></inkscape> - the key path is /options/softproof/enable (read by readProofSettings in src/colors/cms/system.cpp; group id="softproof", attribute enable, in the preferences skeleton; the preferences.xml ROOT ELEMENT MUST BE 'inkscape', see loadImpl in src/preferences.cpp). With softproof enabled the #00ff00 pixel still exports as (0,255,0) +-2 and device-cmyk(1 1 1 1) stays naive-converted (0,0,0); the PDF (exported without the seeded prefs, per stage order) shows the plain device operators and no separation/ICC objects.
